## Definition of Done

- [ ] Unit tests cover the new or changed behavior (a bug fix includes a test that fails without the fix)
- [ ] UI tests cover user-facing changes, with an accessibility check
- [ ] No hard-coded user-visible text (strings are in `packages/i18n/locales/en.json`)
- [ ] Keyboard and screen reader work; shortcuts follow Windows conventions
- [ ] Code follows CODING-STANDARDS.md (self-explanatory names, minimal comments)
- [ ] No new network calls, permissions or capabilities (or agreed in the issue)
- [ ] `just check` passes locally
- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit; commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
